title: RISED: RubrIcs for agentic multi-environment Selection and sElf-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.00979v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training a single LLM agent jointly across diverse interactive environments has attracted increasing attention as a route to generalist agents. Existing curriculum and data-selection strategies often allocate training at the environment level or prioritize local reward-based signals, without explicitly considering relationships between current rollouts across environments for prompt-group selection. Meanwhile, as environments are learned at different rates, all-failure and all-success rollout groups can coexist within a batch, leaving those data without group-relative reward signals. Both challenges highlight limitations of relying solely on scalar rewards in multi-environment RL: they provide limited information about cross-environment relationships and no within-group reward contrast when rewards are identical. translated_title: RISED：用于智能体多环境选择与自蒸馏的评分准则
translated_abstract: 在多样化的交互环境中联合训练单个LLM智能体，正日益受到关注，被视为实现通用智能体的一条路径。现有的课程学习和数据选择策略通常在环境层面分配训练，或优先考虑基于局部奖励的信号，而在选择提示组时没有显式考虑跨环境的当前推演结果之间的关系。与此同时，由于不同环境的学习速度各异，一个批次内可能同时出现全失败和全成功的推演组，导致这些数据缺乏组内相对奖励信号。这两个挑战凸显了在多环境强化学习中仅依赖标量奖励的局限性：标量奖励所提供的跨环境关系信息有限，且当组内奖励完全相同时无法提供组内奖励对比。这促使我们采用更丰富的文本反馈，例如描述推演行为的评分准则，来指导学习。除了评分准则的应用……
tldr: 针对多环境强化学习中标量奖励无法刻画跨环境关系、且在奖励相同时缺乏组内对比的两大局限，提出利用描述推演行为的评分准则作为更丰富的文本反馈，指导单个LLM智能体在多样化交互环境中的多环境选择与自蒸馏训练。
en_tdlr: Proposes RISED, which uses rubrics—richer textual feedback describing rollout behaviors—to overcome the limitations of scalar rewards in multi-environment RL (limited cross-environment relationship information and no within-group reward contrast), enabling multi-environment selection and self-distillation for training a single LLM agent across diverse interactive environments.
